notes.title: BBB Visual Novel Release delayed ... again. Yup. Again.
notes.content:
Hello all!

Just updating everyone as X-MiGuPLAY will be delaying this release. Again. 

The script has been done more or less since (scratches chin, sips some coffee) April 2019ish? One of the draw backs of producing games alone is... when delays happen, it can be like a horse kick in the nuts. But I'm not angry. I love making these games and the delays have been driven by positive things like adding content & getting Anya's voice actress to do an F ton of voices to bring this novel to life. 

So what has happened and where are we at?

1. NSFW Adults ONLY is official. The boobs are on the loose. The final decision has been made to keep this visual novel in its original form and not hold back the content that pushes the game into Adults Only land.

2. With the NSFW state locked in, I added bonus content that is appropriately inappropriate. This game will ship with bonus lapdance content similar to Anya's X-Mas Special. Plus we are including some palette modded BBB Power Claw brawling action too.

3. Voice acting. The decision to add voice acting has contributed greatly to the delays. The novel is approx 22,000 words long and we sat down and recorded every word. Voice recordings wrapped last week. Mixes were done this week and currently the sounds bites are being chopped up and exported for game engine import. 

4. Music. I wrote and arranged new music. That too is time consuming.

I think those are all the talking points I got. Hope to release before August and hope people enjoy it when it is done! Hope everyone out there is staying healthy and safe during these crazy times. Cheers.

-M

notes.title: X-MiGuPLAY NEWS & Site update!
notes.content:
Hello Steam land!

NEWS!

[b]1. X-MiGuPLAY  has updated xmiguplay.com[/b] for 2020. Upcoming games have been added to the site and we tried to pull the site out of the 90s and give it a more modern feel! As always opinions are welcomed!

[b]2. X-MiGuPLAY's Business standing[/b]: How to deliver this without it coming across the [i]wrong way?[/i]

Let me try. So ... we are profitable! Now, we haven't  sold a million copies or anything crazy but, I wanted to announce this. I was doing some marketing research and learned that most indie devs fail in regard to recovering initial investments. 

I am happy to say we have covered our initial investment and while we maintain a small  revolving debt for investments, as any company would, we were stoked to see that we hit this milestone.   

From the outside looking in, it may seem that our traffic is pretty dismal but, as we discovered in our traffic breakdowns, we learned that we've actually ranked on Best Sellers on several occasions. So, long story short, [b]THANK YOU to all that have supported this venture ... 

This truly is a labor of love and we are committed to bringing more content and improving along the way![/b]

[b]3. Bare Boob Brawlerz's's'ss Visual Novel[/b] will come out ... but when it is ready! The delays on this title have been driven by adding more & more illustrative work, which is pretty time consuming. Almost all frames involve scene pre-renders with 3D models and then digitally drawn Manga inspired adaptations. In addition to that, we are scheduling time for voicing the entire thing. Novel is currently pushing 22,000 words and we've surpassed 200 illustrations thus far.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/906560/Bare_Boob_Brawlerz_Novel_01_Visual_Novel/

[b]4. Dr. DONG is coming [/b]: its in pre-production now, core plot scripting, character designs and environmental plotting is pretty much what we are working on now. I hope the game comes out this year but, that could be pretty unrealistic sooooo ... we shall see. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217950/Dr_Dick_Dong_Stripper_Underworld/


That's all I got to blab about. So, thank you and have a dope a$$ weekend!

Regards, 
-M

notes.title: X-MiGu NEWz - new games coming!
notes.content:
Hello all! 

Bare Boob Brawlerz is nearing its double release for Q4 2019. 

There will be the action game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/892160/BARE_BOOB_BRAWLERZ_POWER_CLAW/

and the visual novel:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/906560/Bare_Boob_Brawlerz_Novel_01_Visual_Novel/

Currently, I am expecting to release Power Claw in October and the Visual novel in November/December.

[u][b]THE ACTION GAME:[/b][/u]
The action game is "BARE BOOB BRAWLERZ: POWER CLAW"! This game is launching as a 1 player game. With our success and inundation of quality feedback, this game is very much molded by user feedback colliding with X-MiGu styled entertainment. 

1. Human nudity. While some of our users loved the weirdness of a lavender gray alien being topless in a fighting game, some of our user were like yo, dude ... can we just have women? Like, human women? And I was like yeah brah! While future Stripper Anya titles will continue to explore alien sexuality, the Bare Boob Brawlerz universe is 100% human characters.

2. Game modes. Being a side scrolling and retro fighting game nerd, I know one of the challenges for developers to over come is the monotony of side scrolling games. After your 250th purple and black foot soldier, fighting an evil army can feel a lot like that dish washer job I had in early college. To combat that, I have built BBB Power Claw to feature both a side scrolling fighting game mode and a 1 on 1 fighting game mode. This along with a slew of unique looking enemies with a variety of attack strategies, a robot vacuum cleaner and some environmental damage should help keep the gaming experience fresh. At the same time, I always envisioned my games being played while people were downloading updates for their AAA games that are dozens of Gigs. Also, if you don't have good quality toilet paper, wipe with your left, shake with your right. 

3. Performance: The code, game mechanics and structure of this game are figgity-fresh. That said, new strategy was implemented  on compacting graphical assets and organizing asset usage to maximize use of the 1080 output of the game while ... minimizing memory requirements and increasing animation frames for more bouncing bo.... dont give me that look, you knew what this was! :P

[u][b]The Visual novel![/b][/u]

Bare Boob Brawlerz: Novel 01 (Visual Novel) is in-fact directly related to the action game. In early development, the effort to tell a quality story that could be a giant excuse for a developer to make games with nipples in every fruggin frame transformed into a pretty big story. Though the final length of the story is still being edited and tweaked, the length 'in word' should be inline with what you could expect from a physical novel. Like what ancient man would buy from a store ( I shop mostly online, gives me more time to make games). 

From our forums, I wrote words n' stuff about the game and whatevz...

Bare Boob Brawlerz: Visual Novel follows the story of Vestal who exists in a futuristic version of our planet! Humans hid for countless years underground as beaten and polluted Earth was given centuries to clean its atmosphere without human intervention.

Fast forward to the 'Day of Emergence' and the once noble leaders that executed the brilliant move underground to save humanity have been washed away by political manipulation and evil entities. En-Ti-Tiddies? Anyway...

On a new Earth, smaller outlaw and rebellious groups become the foundation for the onset of the movement to overthrow said ... dun-dun-duuuun ... the bad government people!

About the development:
This Visual Novel has been in development for sometime. The intent is to tell a story that is in-depth and offers complexity. X-MiGu styled entertainment and a healthy dose of originality and of course ... tiddies, blood, and genital mutilation! The artistic intent regarding my approach on how I've drawn the anime styled illustrations is what I would describe as a dark graphic novel look and feel.


[u][b]Other Words[/b][/u]
I donated to the Rainforest Alliance for X-MiGu's annual contribution to the world slash sorry I make tiddie titles fund.
https://www.facebook.com/RainforestAlliance/

I also plan on making a donation to the folks of the Bahamas.

Since X-MiGu launched in 2017, our audience has continued to grow! I put a lot of effort in what is created and published. So, thank you to all that have supported me ... er X-MiGu-me? Anya?  

I am happy to see wishlist and sales growth with every passing month. You can always email at info@xmiguplay.com with feedback or memes. I like EDM and Death Metal too, so feel free to send me any new cool music you have discovered. Oh yeah, if you are not familiar with my first two titles:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/671630/STRIPPER_ANYA_DEMON_SLAYER/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/705700/Stripper_Anya_2_XMiGuFighters/

Cheers!

-M

notes.title: X-MiGu Fighter version 1.3 is live!!
notes.content:
X-MiGu FIGHTERS (XMF) version 1.3 update live!

What's new?

-LOWER SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS: Users now have the option of running the game with Graphics set to HIGH or LOW. This allows most users that don't have an NVIDIA grade graphics card to still enjoy the game. If you are using INTEL HD integrated graphics or equivalent, most modern computers should run the game smoothly. Users that are close to minimum computer specifications may notice improved game play if all other applications are closed and that Windows is not running any background processes. Store front has screen shots of LOW vs HIGH graphics mode.

-MEMORY MANAGEMENT: XMF has new code managing RAM usage. Sprite sheets were rearranged in conjunction with this code to help the game run more efficiently. Users playing XMF before 11.18.2018 will notice the addition of 'loading screens' to help users be aware of when texture data is being preloaded or flushed from system memory.

-SOKO GLITCH PATCH: XMFv1.2 had an index error where when fighting against the AI, the image indexing script would draw the wrong character sprite (SOKONAI blocking) - this has been resolved.

-HEALTH TOO LONG: This change was straight user feedback, initial health value has been reduce to prevent the matches from "dragging on". :)



Thank you everyone that provided X-MiGuPLAY feedback.
Stripper Anya Demon Slayer is up next for a massive update. Check out the store page and wish list the game if you have not purchased it already.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/671630/STRIPPER_ANYA_DEMON_SLAYER/

Coming next is year is our new title BARE BOOB BRAWLERZ: POWER CLAW ... As per customer feedback, this game will feature only female combatants, no aliens or dongs ... we'll maybe one. Alien. No dongs. As promised. Maybe. lol
https://store.steampowered.com/app/892160/BARE_BOOB_BRAWLERZ_POWER_CLAW/



Regards, 
-M

notes.title: X-MiGuFighters is getting a PATCH!
notes.content:
Hello all. 

Today X-MiGu is announcing a patch for X-MiGuFighters that is coming soon.

Why and what to expect?

As I've broken ground on developing Bare BooB Brawlers: Power Claw https://store.steampowered.com/app/892160/BARE_BOOB_BRAWLERZ_POWER_CLAW/
... the first thing I did was look back to X-MiGuFighters and analyze what I wish the game had done better. Some aspects that I would like to improve are so deep rooted into the foundational code that I am hella-scuurd to borke this game. For example, lack of variable air combat and a combo system that could be better.

More importantly, a lot of customer feedback has been analyzed and some interesting issues have been uncovered. In preparation of ensuring Bare Boob Brawlers can be as good as possible for the TNA-DGAF-2D-Fighter community, we will be implementing a patch that should improve this game for everyone and help all our future titles improve.

1. SCREEN RESOLUTION issues and PERFORMANCE issues: When the game launches, it currently launches in Borderless Window mode and at 1920x1080. Most systems auto adjust the screen but for some users, this was not the case. The end result required users to press 'ALT+ENTER' to switch to full screen fixing the porting issues. IN THE PATCH, the game will launch in FULL SCREEN and convert the native resolution automatically to port to the screens resolution. In our testing, we learned that the game ran significantly smother on the affected systems. 

2. 4K ANOMOLY: Users running 4K systems were experiencing "BROKEN GAME PLAY" ... it turns out if you are running a 4K resolution, the game runs really badly on most systems. So, SOME users should see this go away in the new patch, however, some users will have to temporarily configure their screen to 1920x1080 for the game to run properly despite the patch.

3. MEMORY MANAGEMENT: Our ambition is to deliver larger games with smoother 2D animation and more levels and characters. In preparation for our ambitions and intent for BBB:POWERCLAW to have much smother animation-which means more sprites to yield more frames per second ... we have to change our game's MEMORY management code. This patch will introduce a new script for off loading unneeded data that was bogging down VRAM and cause the game's INI time to lag. Though with the patch, you may experience slight lag in between matches caused by the purging of unneeded sprites and loading of new, we are expecting better over all performance and reduction in minimum required specs.

A new announcement will come when the patch is live and thank you!

-M

notes.title: X-MiGuFighters FAQ + X-MiGuPLAYs future
notes.content:
XMF FAQ/IMPORTANT INFO:

UPCOMING PATCHES and NEW GAME FEATURES on X-MiGu FIGHTERs + more:

1.  I can not fix my resolution at start of game. Game screen is too large or too small. 
SOLUTION: Just press "F5" to toggle FULLSCREEN, Should fix the problem.

Requested Game features:

2.  Update 1: 4.2018 CONTROL CUSTOMIZATION. Regarding custom control settings, X-MiGuPLAY (XMP) has broken ground on programming these features in, however, XMP is not going to rush to put the patch live just yet. We want to test as much as possible for bugs and such. Anytime a major update is made to the game's code some undesired side effects can occur.  XMP plans for this feature to go live by April 2018.

3. Update 2: TBA: IMPROVED AI. Some users state that the AI is too easy. The game does offer an easy, normal and hard AI setting. However, some players out there did a great job of exploiting the AI and finding tricks and loops. For that reason, XMP's second planned patch will be an update to the AI, minimal changes will be made on easy setting. However, normal and hard will get AI script updates to remove the current exploits. 

4. Update 3: TBA:  Pausing, Exit & optional HP. The third update will include the addition of a pause and exit round feature. XMP did not integrate a pause feature at launch for a couple reasons. One was the anticipation of online-MP. The other reason is that if you walk away from a CPU match and lose, the game will hold the "Retry/QUIT" Menu until you return. The game can be closed at anytime by pressing "ALT" + "F4". We will add a pause/exit feature and in addition we will add an option to set the Health bar to different levels to accommodate users that prefer faster rounds.

USER concerns/feedback:

5. ANIMATION FRAME RATE: This game occupies an approximate 850 MB in VRAM while it is running (MB can fluctuate due to recolored frames which are flushed from Mem between levels: XMP's goal is typically to stay below the 1GB mark). This is why its critically important for users that are unsure if they meet the system requirements to test the game with an FPS displayed option enabled on the screen during matches. If the game falls below 50 FPS, it will break. It is ideal to hover between 55-60 FPS during matches. Our current engine does not allow for texture pages to be loaded in isolated groups into VRAM as the graphics 'data' file runs like a WAD and is always in Memory. For those reasons many attack animations will  fall to approx 30% of FPS rate. The graphics were planned for true 1080p with minimal interpolation implemented to get the clearest  graphics on the largest display possible based on the memory utilization plan. With the balancing acting of managing sprite sheets, WAD, frame rate and resolution - XMP picked resolution to trump all. 

Further testing on this balancing act will be seen in XMP's next 'beat'em up side scroller brawler'. That next title will run at 720p pushing an up-convert to 1080. The plan is to use the reduction in native resolution so XMP can squeeze in more frames of animation at higher rate. At the end of the day, XMP games are marketed as 'RETRO' as these aspects of production are taken into account. In addition, no changes will be made to XMF in this capacity. 

6. The request for more human females. XMP is working on a re-skin version of XMF to accommodate users that want less Sci-Fi and more strippers fighting with the 1v1 game mechanic of XMF. Release TBA...

7. More Sci Fi, less boobs: To XMP's surprise, we are two nudie titles in and we have users asking for our games but with no nudity. For the reasons express in FAQ#5, XMP does not want to bloat up any release with alt sprites of nude not nude animations. We are currently considering doing a re-skin of XMF with the Sci-Fi minus the bare boobs and sans da schlongulezes. 

8. Smoother Frame Rate: XMP is currently looking into some 3D engine platforms. There is a possibility that by 2020 we could see a 3D Action/RPG styled game from X-MiGuPLAY. 


Final thoughts: X-MiGuPLAY has an international audience that is growing everyday that we are comitted to making games for. We are very open to user feedback so we encourage folks to chime in, sound off.  Continue to post on the forums with your thoughts or continue to email XMP at info@xmiguplay.com for those of you that prefer to lay a little more low key.

Thanks for your time.

Regards, 
-M

If the game falls below 50 FPS, it will break. It is ideal to hover between 55-60 FPS during matches. Our current engine does not allow for texture pages to be loaded in isolated groups into VRAM as the graphics 'data' file runs like a WAD and is always in Memory. For those reasons many attack animations will  fall to approx 30% of FPS rate. The graphics were planned for true 1080p with minimal interpolation implemented to get the clearest  graphics on the largest display possible based on the memory utilization plan. With the balancing acting of managing sprite sheets, WAD, frame rate and resolution - XMP picked resolution to trump all. 

Further testing on this balancing act will be seen in XMP's next 'beat'em up side scroller brawler'. That next title will run at 720p pushing an up-convert to 1080. The plan is to use the reduction in native resolution so XMP can squeeze in more frames of animation at higher rate. At the end of the day, XMP games are marketed as 'RETRO' as these aspects of production are taken into account. In addition, no changes will be made to XMF in this capacity.
